transfer_taxes.name: City of Los Angeles real property transfer tax (base)
transfer_taxes.source_title: LA County Registrar-Recorder: Documentary Transfer Taxes (City of LA, Code 44)
transfer_taxes.notes: $2.25 per $500 = 0.45%, separate from (not credited against) county tax. Customarily seller.

transfer_taxes.name: City of Los Angeles Measure ULA ('mansion tax') surcharge
transfer_taxes.source_title: LA County Registrar-Recorder: Documentary Transfer Taxes (City of LA rates table)
transfer_taxes.notes: Effective 7/1/26: 4% of total value for sales above $5,400,000 and below $10,900,000; 5.5% at $10,900,000+ (7/1/25-6/30/26 thresholds were $5.3M/$10.6M). Thresholds CPI-indexed each July 1. Whole price, on top of base 0.45%. Pending Nov-2026 ballot items (Palisades fire exemption, new multifamily exemption) per law-firm summary https://www.hansonbridgett.com/publications/260812_7087_ula-ordinance-updates. Payer: customarily seller.
